scope: Independent physical and algebraic source review; final existing validation and isolated local-control reports read and checked. No additional broad numerical validation, source edits or evaluations were performed.
evaluation_status: Staged and unevaluated; scientific separation is not evidence of model difficulty.
detector_and_frequency_review: The public probes begin excited and transfer positive energy to the sample. Golden-rule absorption therefore uses Em-En>0 with initial sample population pn and matrix element Sz_mn. The finite-Fock reference uses exactly this ordering.

The defined 2*pi*nu(omega)*|lambda(omega)|^2 already equals gain times the stated omega^2 Gaussian weight. There is no additional 2*pi, normalized-Gaussian prefactor, or detector-emission reversal to apply.
The local operator is Sz=(n_up-n_down)/2. Both the BdG weights and the 64-state reference retain this factor; no extra BdG factor of one half is required in the physical contractions.

The readout is explicitly after the microscopic transient and before depletion in the leading weak-coupling regime. It is not the exactly zero first derivative at t=0 of an isolated finite-time transition probability.
The finite width describes probe spectral weighting, not lifetime broadening of sample levels. The omega^2 factor removes the zero-frequency/elastic contribution.
The validator tests S(-omega)=exp(-omega/T)*S(omega) on grouped underlying spectral lines. It does not impose an invalid detailed-balance identity at the center of a finite spectral window.
BdG_and_Wick_review: For the full doubled Nambu vector Psi=(c,c_dagger), the antisymmetric pairing block gives the Hermitian BdG matrix [[h,Delta],[-Delta_star,-h_transpose]]. This matches the creation-operator ordering in the independent Hamiltonian.
The kernel weights expit(E/T)=1-f(E) represent <Psi(t) Psi_dagger(0)> with phase exp(-i E t). Products of its two factors therefore have the summed signed BdG frequencies used by the code.

The connected density contraction is <c_a_dagger(t)c_b(0)><c_a(t)c_b_dagger(0)> minus <c_a_dagger(t)c_b_dagger(0)><c_a(t)c_b(0)>. The oracle adds the latter with the correct minus sign and spin weights.
At equal time under spin symmetry the local variance is [n(1-n)-|<c_up c_down>|^2]/2. The reported sum-rule check agrees, independently supporting the anomalous sign.

The private reference constructs all fermionic annihilation matrices in the complete 64-state occupation space, builds the Hamiltonian including pairing and its conjugate, then sums actual spin-transition probabilities. It shares neither the BdG contraction formula nor its thermal-kernel implementation.

The six-canonical-mode particle-hole transformation provides an additional normalization check in the existing validator; it uses the local vertex 0.5*diag(P_i,P_i) without redundant-mode double counting.

shortcut_and_overlap_assessment.physical_interpretation: The source keeps exact normal one-particle spectra but treats opposite-spin fluctuations as independent. It can be realized by independent auxiliary number-conserving Gaussian systems having those normal spectra. Its positive stationary thermal line convolution is a coherent physical closure, although it is not the specified paired system.
shortcut_and_overlap_assessment.calibration_nullspace: All calibration preparations have pairing=0, when anomalous contractions vanish. Both controls retain the same nontrivial normal spectra and identify the detector gain.
shortcut_and_overlap_assessment.global_conservation: Singlet pairing preserves total Sz. The source violates that global finite-frequency identity; this is documented as a defect of the approximation and is not used as a zero-signal hidden test. Scored cases measure nonzero one-site rates.
shortcut_and_overlap_assessment.related_retained_family: Superconducting-heat shares BCS background but already includes anomalous phase-sensitive interference, approximating its energy dependence at the gap edge. This task instead discards joint spin covariance despite exact one-particle spectra. It is a defensible distinct measurement/modeling task, without claiming an independent theoretical principle.
shortcut_and_overlap_assessment.later_trial_classification: A retained independent-spin factorization may qualify as a physical failure. Recognition of pair covariance followed by a Wick sign/index error must instead be classified as mathematical or implementation failure. Any failed trial requires source/trajectory review and a fixed-gain repair diagnostic.

input_and_packaging_review.instruction: Exact common neutral instruction permits changing or replacing all helpers/prediction code.
input_and_packaging_review.apparatus: The defining finite Hamiltonian, imposed pair amplitudes, complete Gibbs occupation space, lack of parity constraints, precise local spin operator and probe preparation/coupling are sufficient.
input_and_packaging_review.unearned_hints: No anomalous-contraction formula, independence diagnosis, KMS correction, solver prescription or private case list appears in the public README or instruction.
input_and_packaging_review.calibration: 144 records, constant sigma=.0005 independent of gain and signal, matching public/private bytes, documented input/value/sigma schema.
input_and_packaging_review.public_image: Only README, model, public tests and data are copied from environment. Hint, author material, reference and oracle remain private.
input_and_packaging_review.runtime: Pinned scientific dependencies and unchanged 600-second agent/60-second verifier limits.

grading_review.coverage: Pairing, phase and detector-frequency sweeps of positive one-site signals; additional normal-state anchors pass both closures.
grading_review.margin: Scored paired rates range .0977 to .4814; no near-zero or global-spin scored readout. Reported oracle calibration-noise errors remain below .000418 versus shortcut group minima .22699 or larger.
grading_review.implementation_constraints: Only API, calibration, inferred gain and output accuracy are tested; no internal model, Wick convention, numerical method or solver is mandated.
grading_review.regeneration: Calibration generation is explicitly gated by --generate; ordinary validation preserves both data copies.

reviewed_existing_evidence.limits: Noise samples and 384 public-domain corners are finite validation checks, not an exhaustive proof over continuous controls.

author_packaging_status: Final AUTHOR and provenance read and approved. All 18 source/control hashes and all three final report hashes match. The BCS-family overlap, approximation conservation defect and strict later trial-classification rule are explicitly documented.
